thread:
mia: Quick update — aiming to cut the devex release (SDK v1.4 + quickstarts + sample apps) tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need final OKs on changelog cutoff, packaging, and the quickstart smoke results.

sam: On changelog cutoff — I merged the outline PR but left one item (breaking auth header) as TBD. @priya can you confirm wording?

priya: Yep I'll post the final blurb in the changelog PR by EOD. Also tagging the deprecations note — should we include migration snippet? :thinking_face:

jordan: Quickstarts status: all three languages build locally. Node sample fails one test (env var read) — I pushed a tiny fix in sample-node#42. Need a review from @alex.

alex: Looking now. If it's just the env read we can merge. Pinged a quick CR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-node/pull/42 :eyes:

mia: Packaging: @sam — do you have the release artifact names? I want the console copy to match exactly.

sam: Artifact names will be: redwood-sdk-js-v1.4.tgz, redwood-sdk-py-1.4.whl, quickstarts-1.4.zip. I'll upload to staging bucket after CI passes.

docs-bot: Automated check: docs build passes for main branch. Broken links found in quickstarts/embedded-readme.md -> line 18.

priya: I'll fix that link now. Also adding the migration snippet to changelog as discussed.

qa-bot: Smoke tests queued on ci/smoke/devex-1.4. Expected runtime ~12m. Will comment results here.

jordan: @qa-bot note: the node sample test that was failing is included in smoke list. I added a retry wrapper to avoid flakes.

alex: Merged sample-node#42. Can we get a quick packaging run? I'm free for the next hour.

sam: Starting packaging job locally:

```
make build-artifacts
aws s3 cp dist/* s3://redwood-devex-releases/staging/1.4/ --acl private
```

sam: If CI agrees, artifacts should appear in staging in ~8m.

qa-bot: Smoke run finished: all checks green except quickstart:node:e2e (1 flaky failure). Investigating...

mia: Is the flaky failure the same env-var thing or new?

qa-bot: Same env-var, but retried 2x and passed on retry. Marked as flaky.

priya: Changelog PR updated and merged. Text: "Auth header format changed: use X-Redwood-Auth v2; migration snippet included."

alex: Verified packaging artifacts uploaded. Links: s3://redwood-devex-releases/staging/1.4/redwood-sdk-js-v1.4.tgz etc.

mia: Two asks before we call freeze: 1) @sam confirm artifacts exist and checksums posted; 2) @jordan confirm sample app quickstart README includes the small env note and a runnable command example.

sam: Checksums posted at https://staging.redwood.devex/releases/1.4/checksums.txt 

jordan: README updated and sample run command added. Example:

```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...
npm run quickstart
```

priya: Last item: docs landing page needs the download links updated to staging URIs so QA can smoke the deploy. I'll make that change in the next 15m.

mia: Perfect. If nothing else pops in the next hour, I'll announce the changelog cutoff and tag the release candidate. Can folks react with :thumbsup: if they are good with proceeding?

sam: :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup:

mia: OK marking cutoff. I'll create the release-candidate branch and kick the final CI. Deploy bot, please run the canary smoke once artifacts promoted.

deploy-bot: Received release-candidate/1.4. Initiating canary smoke on staging -> canary-1.4. Will report back in ~15m.

qa-bot: Canary smoke started. Running through quickstarts, SDK import tests, and basic auth flow.

mia: Thanks all — if you see any post-cutoff urgent fixes, post here and tag me. Otherwise I'll post the RC announcement in #announcements once canary is green.

deploy-bot: Canary results: PASS (all smoke tests green). No regressions detected.

mia: RC looks good. I'll prepare the release notes and schedule the GA promotion for 24h unless any blocking issues are raised. Closing this thread for day-of coordination. :party_parrot:
